name: Terry & Rachel Dodson
description: Terry Dodson is a renowned American comic book artist known for his dynamic, expressive linework and elegant character designs. He has illustrated major titles for Marvel and DC Comics, including Wonder Woman , X-Men , and Harley Quinn . His style blends classic comic aesthetics with a modern, polished flair. Rachel Dodson , his wife and longtime collaborator, is a talented colorist whose rich, vibrant palettes bring Terry’s illustrations to life. Her work enhances mood and depth, contributing to the signature look of their joint projects. Together, they form one of the most celebrated artistic duos in contemporary comics.
